title: The Three Legged Lookout Stool
youtube_title: The Three Legged Lookout Stool | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness can be as simple as carrying the thing someone else needs for a rest.
summary: Elodie finds the keeper's three-legged wooden stool wobbling on the cottage step and carries it up to the windy lookout so he can sit while he watches the boats.
